purpose: Audit every Stage-A2 adjudication row from Hive job 21444606 and preserve the reason the result cannot feed Stage B.
comparison: The audit compares 29 authenticated model outputs covering the frozen 206-line exception ledger with the suffix-d schema and semantic gates. It also inspects every model decision, including decisions retained inside the three invalid rows.
assumptions: The suffix-d input manifest and downloaded job directory named below are the authoritative bytes.
A Slurm exit code of 2:0 reflects the runner's deliberate fail-closed result after all model calls stopped normally; it is not truncation or a missing-output failure.

The correction may constrain the guided schema to decisions that are already permitted by each authenticated exception reason and allowed-anchor ledger. It must not encode the expected semantic answer for a named control.
No Stage B or full-corpus job was submitted from this result.

failure_diagnosis.verdict: The shared guided schema admitted decisions that the reason-aware Python validator correctly rejects.

content_gate_result.reason: A technically parsed unowned-continuation item attached the Army/Defense disclaimer to an endorsement anchor. The frozen pilot expects that line to terminate as nonrecord content.

approved_narrow_correction.guided_schema: Condition each target slot on its authenticated exception reason. Unclear and candidate-review slots may choose role, an exact allowed attachment when present, or withheld_validation. Unowned-continuation slots may choose an exact allowed attachment, not_continuation, or withheld_validation.
approved_narrow_correction.anchor_rule: The attach_to_anchor schema uses an enum of the exact ordered authenticated allowed-anchor IDs. The target line itself is excluded.
approved_narrow_correction.next_gate: Independent review must approve the corrected contract and a fresh immutable suffix before any Hive rerun. A rerun remains content NO-GO if the Army/Defense disclaimer is attached again.
